none: PAS CAM-5EEC32: Roman Coin : A copper-alloy nummus of the House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy nummus of the House of Constantine. AD330-335, (Reece period 17). Reverse legend reads GLORIA EXERCITVS. Reverse shows Two soldiers, two standards. Mint unknown. Obverse shows Unclear bust right. Obverse legend is illegible. Reverse fields and exergue read: / //[...]. Condition is fine, die axis is 6 o'clock, weight is 1.1g, diameter is 14mm
